hint: Name, colours, links, rules and opening curtain: everything that makes this panel your server’s own.
modAbsentTexte: Customisation is saved by the Eco Agora server mod (Mods/EcoAgora/). Install it and restart the server: in the meantime, the panel uses its default values.

erreurs.couleur: The colour must be in #rrggbb format.
erreurs.port: The port must be a number between 0 and 65535.
erreurs.date: The opening curtain is enabled but its date is empty.

toasts.enregistreTexte: Visible to all visitors on their next page load.
toasts.chargeTexte: Review it, then save to publish.
toasts.illisibleTexte: A site.json file exported from this page is expected.

confirmQuitter: Some changes have not been saved. Leave anyway?

identite.langueAide: Each visitor can change it. Texts: WebClient/WebBin/lang/.
identite.baselinePlaceholder: Shown when the server has no description.
identite.logoAide: Square image. Empty: Eco Agora logo. A file placed in WebClient/WebBin/ is referenced as /file-name.png.

jeu.hoteAide: IP or domain name. Empty: this site’s address.
jeu.secoursAide: Offered when hovering over the button, for example a domain name in addition to the IP.

liens.noteDiscord: The Discord link comes from the Eco server configuration (Administration › Configuration).

reglement.finale: Final section: full width, with the meteor countdown

ouverture.note: Before the date, the whole panel is hidden behind a countdown. On the day, an animation opens it, and the curtain never comes back. To actually block access to the game, use the mod’s waiting room (Configs/EcoAgora.eco) or the server password.
ouverture.dateAide: Your browser’s time, saved with its time zone.
ouverture.motDePasseAide: Not a security measure: anyone can read it in the page.
ouverture.sousTitrePlaceholder: The server opens on Saturday at 8 pm.
